design: one compound request versus two host-split facet requests; same source document, all calls linked within one source cluster

freshnessAudit.limitation: The audit cannot exclude an earlier provider-visible excerpt or paraphrase not retained in run artifacts.

questions.compound: Both facets plus preserve the explicit causal caveat about alias duplication.
questions.facetA: Publication/maintenance roots and stale-close outcome in the read-only resume.
questions.facetB: Exact context budgets, duplicate owner aliases, and the stated limit on causal attribution.

primaryMetrics: expected range present in search for each request
selected/fetched range relevance reviewed from literal text
exact source revision, offset slice, fingerprint and pack verification
union includes both facet ranges with exact citations
host-composed paragraph covers both facets without overstating causality

blindReview.input: anonymized queries, selected literal evidence, union pack and host-authored answer; omit ids, scores, labels, status and source path

independentUnit: one previously unexposed source-document candidate; three linked requests are not independent samples

minimumSupport.interpretation: reporting floor; this three-request single-cluster pilot is descriptive only

uncertaintyMethod: raw counts only; no inference or calibration
hostCompositionConstraints: compose only from exact ranges selected and fetched in the two facet requests
preserve exact citations to each returned range
explicitly state alias duplication is not established as the root cause
if either facet selection is missing or unsupported, report union incomplete and do not substitute the expected target range
